title: Internal error occurred
body:
I encountered an internal error while running `mypy --py2 tools/print-all/print-all`. [print-all](https://github.com/zulip/zulip/blob/master/tools/print-all/print-all#L135) is a python 2 script in Zulip.

This script is not annotated at all.

I used the latest version of mypy from this repository (f3c1c55). I also tested it on the version available on pypi. Both of them are throwing this internal error.
